text:
Dana (CSM): Heads-up — renewal for Helios hitting in ~6 weeks. They want a 10‑mo term (instead of 12), split invoicing across two EU subsidiaries, VAT lines on each invoice, procurement needs our vendor code, and Legal is asking for a data‑residency clause. They also say EU signers need eIDAS‑compliant signatures. Product usage is down last 30d — flagging as medium risk. Can we get pricing impact, PO path, and Docusign/eIDAS guidance? cc @Priya (AM) @Elena (Procurement)

Priya (AM): Thanks — can you paste the current quote id and current term? Did they ask for seat changes or added modules? If we go to 10 mo, need proration math.

Dana (CSM): Quote: Q-2025-1142. Current is 12 mo @ $120k ARR. They want 10 mo, no seat count change, and asked to add the "Optimize" bundle (+$15k/yr). Ballpark expected commit ~ $95k for the new term after proration. Low usage is the bigger risk here.

Carl (SE): On enablement side — they want training the week after signing and the On‑Prem connector added to the SOW. Is that covered in the current quote? If not, estimate +$8k one‑time.

Elena (Procurement): For invoicing we'll need: our vendor code (we can provide), and the customer will send two POs. They want invoices split: 
 - Helios EU Holding (VAT ID: EU123456) — 70% of fees
 - Helios Software Ltd (VAT ID: EU654321) — 30% of fees
They require PO numbers on each invoice and Net30. Payment method: they prefer ACH, but accounting team often pushes wire. Who owns collections on our side? Also they asked invoices to show VAT breakdown per entity.

Dana (CSM): Billing contact at customer: maria@helios-eu.com. Procurement said they'll issue two POs referencing the split. We need to confirm our billing engine can emit two invoices with correct VAT lines.

Priya (AM): Finance question — can our billing produce two invoices to two different VAT entities for one contract? @AccountingTeam please advise. Also need to know consequences for revenue recognition.

LegalBot: Legal review requested. Customer wants a data‑residency clause ("customer data stored in EU region") and a small termination tweak. They also require eIDAS‑compliant signature for EU signers — confirm whether Docusign with ID verification is acceptable or if wet signature is required for either entity.

Elena (Procurement): Also they asked for our company vendor code, a certificate of insurance, and invoice language both in English and their local language. They want the VAT number on each invoice line.

Carl (SE): SOW snippet to add for On‑Prem connector (for quote update):
```
LineItem: On‑Prem Connector
Qty: 1
OneTime: $8000
Notes: Custom deliverable, 6‑week delivery SLA post SOW sign
```

Dana (CSM): Action items (summary):
1) Priya: update Q-2025-1142 with 10‑mo proration + Optimize bundle + On‑Prem connector line.
2) Elena: request vendor code and confirm both PO numbers + VAT format from customer.
3) Legal: confirm eIDAS vs wet signature and review data‑residency language.
4) Finance/Accounting: confirm ability to issue two invoices to two entities and preferred payment method (ACH vs wire).
5) Me: hold off scheduling enablement until SOW signed.
Need everything by 1748654800 to hit internal renewal timeline. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya (AM): I'll update the quote today and ping accounting. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Elena (Procurement): I'll ask customer for the two PO numbers and vendor mappings today.

LegalBot: Noted — Legal will confirm Docusign + ID verification vs wet signature by EOD tomorrow.

Dana (CSM): Thanks all — I'll flag account health and prep renewal playbook. Please add blockers here if anything changes.
